admin.enabled_help: Adds a View button to PDFs, Word files and spreadsheets in posts. Turn it off to leave every file as a normal link.
admin.types_help: Which files get a View button. The others stay normal links.
admin.mode_help: Full screen covers the page. In the post opens the viewer under the file. Phones always get full screen.
admin.fof_upload_help: With FoF Upload, these files work out of the box: their download buttons get a View button. For a card with the file name, size and page count, open FoF Upload's settings and choose the Document card template for application/pdf, Word and spreadsheet types.

template.name: Document card (Lectern)
template.description: Shows a PDF, Word file or spreadsheet as a card with its name, size and page or sheet count, a View button that opens the viewer, and a download button.
